description: One reviewer's judgment about one primary subject, with zero or more findings anchored into the subjects the review was exposed to.

body/findings.label: Findings
body/findings.description: Optional in the declared sense only: an `accept` or `inconclusive` review may carry none, while `changes-required` cannot.

body/findings/*/blocking.label: Blocking
body/findings/*/blocking.description: Absence decodes to false, which an observation, low or medium finding may legitimately be, so this cannot be declared required. A high or critical finding must set it.

body/findings/*/category.label: Category
body/findings/*/category.description: An open set. Nothing constrains which categories exist.

go_only_rules.rule: A changes-required conclusion requires at least one finding whose blocking flag is set.
An accept conclusion may not contain any finding whose blocking flag is set.
An observation finding may not be blocking; a high or critical finding must be; low and medium may be either.
Every finding whose severity is not observation requires at least one evidence anchor.
An anchor's subject must name a subject this record declares.

The locator kind decides which locator fields must be present and forbids the rest: file-lines and log-lines require a canonical relative path with a positive start and an end at or after it; byte-range requires a path with a nonnegative start and an end strictly after it; json-pointer requires a valid non-root JSON pointer alone; opaque requires a value alone.
Nothing verifies that an anchor points at anything. Anchor content hashes are deferred, so every locator detail is a producer claim.
